title: Books with hearts
description: This resource pack changes the texture of the GUI of the book.
body:
# Books With Hearts
Add a cute and cozy touch to your writing experience in Minecraft!
This resource pack updates the Book & Quill GUI, decorating each page with adorable heart icons, giving your in‑game writing a warm and charming aesthetic.

### Why download it?

- Adorable Aesthetic: Heart‑themed pages make every journal, story, or note feel special.
- Perfect for Roleplay & Creative Writing: Amazing for SMP storytelling, lore keepers, romance‑themed builds, or immersive servers.
- Vanilla‑Friendly: The hearts blend naturally with Minecraft’s original interface.
- Lightweight & Compatible: Works effortlessly with shaders, UI packs, and text‑related resources.

Write your stories with heart — literally!

## Terms of Use

You are free to use this resource pack in Minecraft, your videos, and your modpacks.

If you include it in a modpack or showcase it in a video, I would appreciate it if you add a link to this page in the description.

_**Do not redistribute or claim the pack as your own.**_
